definition.tau: Use first original saved M/B action disagreement once, without searching for a year that improves outcomes. Keep no-disagreement pair withNULL intervention, no replacement.

definition.control: From saved state beforetau, execute originalM action at tau then recalculate original frozen policy from subsequent actual states; must match savedM physical accounts/actions/Q and terminal results.
definition.treatment: Replace only tau action with originalB action; pay its own exact fee and apply actual common return. Fromtau+1 recalculate originalpi using its fixed original trainingfan/target/eta/H and own branch state. Absorbing pending overrides all future automation once own breach occurs.
definition.estimand: Difference in terminal wealth, net total log growth, original whole-history MDD and breach/first-crossing between the two branches on this fixed original market path. Includes downstream policy feedback.
definition.no_policy_selection: Force chosen B action regardless of whether original score gate would allow it. It is a controlled intervention diagnostic, not a recommended transaction or a newly approved strategy.
